meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 需要查 X/Twitter 上的讨论时,Claude 会调用 x_search 工具,按日期、指定账号和关键词拆成 2~3 次检索,并与网页搜索对照,汇报时附上 x.com 链接。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索 X/Twitter、查推文,或想了解「X 上大家在说什么」等社交信号时触发;前提是已连接 xAI 账号,否则它会说明不可用并改用网页搜索。

say.text: 搜一下 X 上这两天关于英伟达的最新讨论
say.note: 会做带日期的关键词检索,并附 x.com 链接

say.text: 把这条推文的回复和引用也拉出来看看
say.note: 会单独做一次线程抓取

howto.what_en: When you need X/Twitter discussions, Claude calls the x_search tool, splitting the work into 2-3 date-bounded, account- and keyword-scoped searches, checks them against web_search, and reports with x.com links.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for X/Twitter search, tweets, or what people are saying on X. Requires a connected xAI account; otherwise it says x_search is unavailable and falls back to web_search.

say_en.text: Search X for the latest posts about Nvidia from the past two days
say_en.note: Runs a date-bounded keyword search and cites x.com links

say_en.text: Only look at posts from @growth_papa and @aleabitoreddit
say_en.note: Uses allowed_x_handles to scope trusted accounts

say_en.text: Pull the replies and quotes for that post too
